correctness.rationale: D_n counts boundaries between consecutive *labels* assigned to different cycles, not adjacent elements in a cycle ordering. Unique maximal runs in the label-ordered cycle partition have compositions ell_1+...+ell_r=n (r=d+1), with nonconsecutive equal-block partition of runs; number of permutations with those cycle memberships is exactly product_B(sum_{j in B}ell_j-1)!. Fix r: an individual largest cycle size m<=n/2 has exponentially small normalized weight; if m>n/2, s=n-m small, t runs of that large cycle are nonadjacent (t<=ceil(r/2)), so contribution O_r(n^(t-s-2)). The only order n^-1 configurations when r=2k+1 have one large cycle occupying alternating k+1 runs and k exceptional singleton labels, giving k! C(n-k-1,k)(n-k-1)!/n!~1/n. For r=2k+2, two alternations with k+1 singleton exceptions contribute 2(k+1)! C(n-k-2,k)(n-k-2)!/n!~(2k+2)/n²; all others lower-order. Independently enumerated every permutation n<=7 and independently summed the weighted composition formula for all eight d values at n=8, matching vector (5040,1812,6042,5539,7744,7134,5102,1907). Additional exact composition probabilities for fixed d=0..3 and n=12,20,30 corroborate the two scaled limits. Finite tests supplement asymptotic dominance proof.
